items.author: Chief Systems Engineer
items.text: The G1000 NXi decision also locks us into the Garmin Connext ecosystem for future upgrades (GWX 75 weather radar, GFC 700 autopilot).  This is a strategic advantage — the alternative (G500 TXi) has a narrower upgrade path.

items.author: Structures Engineer
items.text: Main spar forging supplier (Alcoa) has confirmed 16-week lead time for the 0523001-2 extrusion.  Order must be placed by CDR to avoid delaying the first structural test article.

items.author: Avionics Integration
items.text: LED lighting retrofit is a good candidate for the first STC batch.  Whelen PARmetheus direct-replacement bulbs have the same base and  beam pattern as the halogen originals.  Recommend field trial on  two fleet aircraft before fleet-wide approval.

items.author: Powerplant Lead
items.text: Engine failure probability modelled at 1.2 × 10⁻⁵ per flight hour based on Lycoming fleet data.  Well within the FAR 33 continued airworthiness threshold.  Dual magnetos are the primary mitigation — single-mag failure is non-catastrophic.

items.author: Flight Test
items.text: Stall warning horn calibration verified in flight.  Clean stall: V_S1 = 48 KCAS, horn at 55 KCAS (7 kn margin).  Full flap: V_S0 = 40 KCAS, horn at 47 KCAS (7 kn margin).  Both within the 5-10 kn specification.

items.author: Test Pilot
items.text: Aileron roll rate at Va measured at 42°/s (clean).  This is within the acceptable range for a training aircraft (40-60°/s).  No adverse yaw noted during flight test — Frise/differential combination is effective.

items.author: Electrical Systems
items.text: Battery endurance test at −20°C showed 28 min to essential bus dropout (vs 30 min spec).  Cold-soak effect reduces SLA capacity by ~15%.  Consider upgrading to 18 Ah battery for cold-weather margin.

items.author: Structures Engineer
items.text: Main spar ultimate load FEA complete.  Positive margin of 12% at +3.8g.  Recommend physical load test to validate FEA boundary conditions.

items.author: Avionics Lead
items.text: G1000 NXi software baseline is v0582.05.  Confirm with Garmin that this includes the WAAS/SBAS LPV unlock.  Supplier lead time: 16 weeks.

items.author: Chief Systems Engineer
items.text: All FAR Part 23 Amendment 64 references verified against current eCFR text.  Amendment 65 (effective 2025) adds active CO detector mandate — see AD2024001.
